text:
Riya (People Ops): Heads-up ":wave:" uploaded handbook amendment: 'Parental Leave - Notice & Return-to-Work Steps'. Need quick manager ack plan and brief training.

Tom (Eng Manager): Skimmed. Do we require 30-day notice for reduced hours after return?

Riya (People Ops): No, reduced-hours request is optional. We added an example timeline and a short form managers can use.

Ellen (HR-Intl): For EMEA, added a country note for parental leave pay top-ups. Link in the draft.

Sam (Hiring Ops): I can run manager export and send per-manager ack links. Suggest two waves: managers with >4 directs first.

Riya (People Ops): Yes please. Target 7 business days. Reminders day 0, day 3. If ack rate <60% escalate to leads.

Tom (Eng Manager): Can we get a 15-min recorded briefing for managers?

Ellen (HR-Intl): I can record one at 09:00 CET and upload captions.

ack-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook update: Parental Leave amendment - manager ack due in 7d" 

Riya (People Ops): Manager checklist (short):
- Share timelines with direct reports
- Use manager form for any retro-pay/top-up requests
- Complete handbook ack in 7 days
- Schedule 1:1 to discuss return plan

Tom (Eng Manager): Got it, will review and DM two edge cases by EOD.
